# `catchToIgnore`

Suggests using Effect.ignore or Effect.ignoreCause instead of Effect.catch/catchCause returning Effect.void

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377099` |
| Language Service name | `catchToIgnore` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/catch-to-ignore` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<void, string, never>

export const recovered = program.pipe(
  Effect.catch(() => Effect.void)
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(catch-to-ignore): `Effect.ignore` expresses ignored failure more directly than `Effect.catch` returning `Effect.void`.
*/
)
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "catchToIgnore": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Oxlint Configuration

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "plugins": ["effecttsgo"],
  "rules": {
    "effecttsgo/catch-to-ignore": "warn"
  }
}
```
